fee_rules.title: Monthly maintenance fee
lines: Waived for the statement period when you have direct deposits totaling $500 or more during it.
Also waived when you keep a $1,500 minimum daily balance, or when the primary owner is under 25.
Assessed on the last day of each statement period (the calendar month).

fee_rules.title: Overdraft fee
lines: Charged when we pay an item that overdraws your account.
No fee if your account is overdrawn by $50.00 or less at the end of the business day.
Maximum 2 overdraft fees per day ($24.00).
No fee on items of $5.00 or less.

fee_rules.title: Overdraft protection options
lines: Overdraft Transfer: we move money from your linked Harborline Savings to cover the shortfall. No transfer fee.
Standard overdraft coverage (your current setting): we may pay the item and charge the $12.00 overdraft fee.
Decline instead: card purchases and ATM withdrawals that would overdraw are declined, with no fee.
Change your option in the app or by calling us; Kai can't change it for you.

fee_rules.title: Foreign transaction fee
lines: Applies to debit card purchases and ATM withdrawals made in a foreign currency or processed outside the US.
Shown as a separate line on the same day as the purchase.

fee_rules.title: ATM fees
lines: Free at 32,000+ Harborline and partner ATMs (find them in the app).
$3.00 Harborline fee for each withdrawal, transfer or balance inquiry at other ATMs.
The ATM's owner may add its own surcharge.

Reimbursements: Everyday Checking reimburses up to 2 out-of-network Harborline fees per statement period when you have $2,500+ in direct deposits that period. ATM owner surcharges aren't reimbursed on Everyday Checking.
International ATM withdrawals: $3.00 fee plus the 3% foreign transaction fee.

fee_rules.title: Wire transfers
lines: Incoming domestic wire: $15.00.
Outgoing domestic wire: $25.00.
Incoming international wire: $15.00.
Outgoing international wire: $45.00.

fee_rules.title: Daily debit card and ATM limits
lines: Debit card purchases: up to $3,000 per day.
ATM cash withdrawals: up to $500 per day.
Limits reset at midnight Pacific time. Temporary increases are reviewed by phone.

fee_rules.title: Zelle limits
lines: Send up to $1,000 per day and $5,000 per rolling 30 days.
Money sent to an enrolled recipient usually arrives in minutes and generally can't be canceled.

fee_rules.title: Linked savings rates (Harborline Savings ••7730)
lines: Standard rate: 0.01% APY.
Bonus rate: 3.80% APY on balances up to $50,000 for any month you transfer $100 or more into savings and make no more than 2 withdrawals.
Balances over $50,000 earn 0.01% APY. Rates are variable and can change. APYs as of Oct 16, 2026 (fictional demo rates).
Your Oct 5 transfer of $200 qualifies October for the bonus rate.

fee_rules.title: Pending vs. posted
lines: Pending: the merchant has authorized the amount and it's held from your available balance, but it isn't final. The amount can change or the hold can drop off.
Posted: final and included in your current balance.
A pending hold that matches a posted charge often drops off within 1 to 3 business days. If both post, you can request a review.

fee_rules.title: Disputing a charge
lines: Wait until the charge has posted; pending charges can't be disputed yet.
Contact the merchant first if you can; many fix duplicate charges quickly.
Then request a review in the app (Activity > the charge > Report a problem) or call 1-800-555-0199, within 60 days of the statement it first appeared on.
We usually reply within 10 business days and may give a temporary credit while we review. A refund isn't guaranteed.
